One not-insignificant issue I noticed either way though:

Incident 860-██-12: On ██/██/████, ██ days after Exploration IV, SCP-860 was found on Dr. ███'s office table, ████ m from its containment unit. The item's containment locker had not been opened. Video surveillance from ██:██ AM shows the key suddenly materializing on top of the table. It is currently unknown how or why SCP-860 was moved. The incident had a profound effect on Dr. ███. Psychiatric evaluation is recommended.

This object is NOT Safe.

item.title: images replaced
item.content:encoded:
Reverted because I jumped the gun and am dumb

I hate to make changes to such an old and established SCP, but someone pointed out that the provenance of the original images are uncertain. In fact, it's likely one of the original images was a frame from a popular motion picture.

In response to the concerns, InitHello provided a color-manipulated photo they'd taken of one of their own keys, and I found a photo of a misty forest on an online repository of public domain images. The new images have been substituted, and I have left the old files intact in case someone wants to take further action on this or revert.
